role: WorldServer's scheduled block update set: scheduleBlockUpdate/func_147454_a with the scheduledUpdatesAreImmediate branch (liquids and falling blocks updated at once during worldgen), the NextTickListEntry pending TreeSet as a min-heap plus a HashSet dedupe, chunk-load entries and the per-chunk pending query.

structs.name: tick_entry
structs.java: NextTickListEntry (xCoord, yCoord, zCoord, block, scheduledTime, priority, tickEntryID)

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
function heap_push: growth of the pending heap by a quarter, in the arena's slab (slab_grow; ticks_pop gives room back the same way) (lane/querybounds, TM-06)
function set_resize: the doubled or halved hash table is a slab block, the old one given back after the rehash (lane/querybounds, TM-06)
function ticks_peek: a peek of up to TICKS_PEEK_MAX (16) candidates uses a stack array (the tick peeks one); a check that reads the whole set gets a heap (lane/gpuarena, L3)
function ticks_walk: a slab copy of the heap per call, qsorted (ticks_save's backup and ticks_peek's large candidate heap are slab blocks too) (lane/querybounds, TM-06)
line 379, function ticks_chunk_updates: qsort of the result
lines 216-223 and 234, set_contains/set_add: open-addressing probe loops bounded only by the load factor
line 100, function falling_update_now: while loop dropping the block down to the first non-passable block
line 43, world_rand: pointer to an external Random, installed by the server tick

ticks_schedule_block_update runs its immediate liquid and falling updates on the block worklist (blockwl.h): the SCHED op, liquid_step, the falling block's FALL_TAIL; set_grow reinserts through set_insert (no recursion)
notes: The pending set's order is the TreeSet's (time, priority, entry id) carried as data in a heap, so container order is not a hazard for pop, but ticks_walk and ticks_peek rebuild that order per call. The dedupe hash uses backward-shift deletion. Only the immediate branch's updateTick dispatch lives here (ids 8-13); the consuming tickUpdates loop is elsewhere (servertick.c per the header comment, not verified line by line). ticks_liquid_tick_rate returns 10 for any non-zero dimension, ticks_liquid_tick_rate_world only for dim -1. Tests listed are those that include ticks.h; not verified which of them exercise each entry point.
